versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_susp_netsh_command.yml
versions.detection:
network_cmd1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'netsh '
        - 'show '
network_cmd2:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'advfirewall '
        - 'firewall '
network_cmd3:
      CommandLine|contains:
        - 'config '
        - 'state '
        - 'rule '
        - 'name=all'
condition: network_cmd1 and network_cmd2 and network_cmd3
versions.spl: CommandLine="*netsh *" CommandLine="*show *" CommandLine IN ("*advfirewall *", "*firewall *") CommandLine IN ("*config *", "*state *", "*rule *", "*name=all*")
